notes: Seven movable-part episodes are visible. The two coat-closet leaves and two laundry-closet doors are reported separately because they are distinct hinged parts, although sparse sampling makes their individual transition ordering less certain. The initial hallway survey and later inspections of closet, refrigerator, laundry, and cabinet contents were not counted as additional state changes.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment entry hall, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user sequentially opens and closes closet doors, a refrigerator, an upper cabinet, and a lower drawer.
